html.editor.html.sunoforge_create_and_so: SunoForge Create and song editor: pick what to make, the part of the song, the lyrics, the styles and the options; the last button writes it all into the chat.
html.editor.html.1_1_one_bar_1_1_a_tenth: −1 / +1 — one bar · −.1 / +.1 — a tenth of a second · type m:ss.mmm for milliseconds
html.editor.html.suno_sliders_stay_auto_: Suno sliders stay “auto” until moved; Variety 0 keeps your Style as written. Max Mode: ask for it in words (twice the credits).
js.editor.html.T.an: Analysis: tempo, key, sections, the words as sung
js.editor.html.T.h_simple: Describe the song in a sentence; Suno writes the lyrics and the style itself.
js.editor.html.T.h_new: Lyrics and styles of your own, like Advanced in the Suno app.
js.editor.html.T.h_speech: A script read over music. Suno rewrites the Tone in every take: treat it as a wish.
js.editor.html.T.h_loop: Suno Sounds: two sound effects, one-shots or loops, at your BPM and key; 1 credit a sound (Pro and up).
js.editor.html.T.h_extend: Continue from one point. The new part replaces everything after it; the take holds only the continuation, and S5 joins it into one song for free. The point is sent in seconds with milliseconds; how finely Suno cuts was not tested.
js.editor.html.T.h_cover: A cover sings the whole song again: through the connector no part can be chosen. The lyrics below go in; without them the cover comes out instrumental.
js.editor.html.T.h_mashup: Two songs blended into one. It sings only with lyrics. The second song is picked from your list after the button.
js.editor.html.T.h_replace: Suno redoes the chosen place and keeps the rest of the song’s own audio. One change per place: a line, a time range, a section, an instrument. More than 5 changed places re-sing the whole song as a cover. 10 credits, two takes.
js.editor.html.T.h_text: Changes the title and lyrics stored in your library. The sound stays the same.
js.editor.html.T.h_reuse: A new song from this one’s lyrics and styles, like "reuse prompt" in the Suno app.
js.editor.html.T.nudge_n: −1 / +1 — one bar · −.1 / +.1 — a tenth of a second · type m:ss.mmm for milliseconds
js.editor.html.T.suno_n: Suno sliders stay "auto" until moved; Variety 0 keeps your Style as written. Max Mode: ask for it in words (twice the credits).
js.editor.html.T.title: Song title
js.editor.html.T.app: In the Suno app only: Personalize, Inspiration, image and video as input, recording audio, saved lyrics and styles.
js.editor.html.T.copyhint: Select the text below and copy it
js.editor.html.T.sent: Written into the chat. Nothing is sent to Suno and nothing is spent until the card and your yes.
js.editor.html.T.ph_desc: A song about…, mood, genre, who sings
js.editor.html.T.ph_ext: Lyrics for the new part. Empty: Suno writes them; Instrumental: none.
js.editor.html.T.ph_sound: What it should sound like: instruments, groove, texture
js.editor.html.T.qa.rhyme: Lyrics: tighten the rhymes, keep the meaning and the number of lines
js.editor.html.T.qa.short: Lyrics: shorten the long lines to fit the beat
js.editor.html.T.qa.stress: Lyrics: check where the stresses fall against the beat
js.editor.html.T.qa.new: Lyrics: write a new part in the same voice and meter
js.editor.html.T.qa.s_short: Style: make it shorter, under 400 characters, keep the sound
js.editor.html.T.qa.s_genre: Style: the same song in another genre — ask me which

html.mcp.html.12_parts_list: 12 parts: vocals, backing vocals, drums, bass, guitar, keys, percussion, strings, synth, FX, brass, woodwinds — parts the song does not have come back almost silent.
html.mcp.html.stems_note: Both takes are split, in about a minute. Parts the song does not have come back almost silent or with another instrument bleeding in. Each stem is a private song and cannot be split again.
html.mcp.html.stems_done_note: ▶ plays the part in Suno’s player. MIDI of a stem costs nothing; MIDI needs a Premier plan.
html.mcp.html.midi_note: A .mid up to 256 KB becomes a new song (v6-wild, Pro and Premier): the upload is free, the song costs 10 credits after the card. Lab: experimental.
html.mcp.html.midi_blank_note: Then the card: style and lyrics, 10 credits, two takes. Each take passes Suno’s copyright check on its own; a take that fails is not charged.
